transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Awards Producer. I wanted to get us together to work through the presentation protocol for the Horizon Feature Award on Saturday evening. The current draft rundown has a few specifics we need to review — south stairs for the recipient, a 30-second stage cue, no broadcast delay, the festival sponsor wall as backdrop, and a 42-inch podium. Before I can lock the rundown, festival production policy requires round-robin sign-off from stage management, broadcast standards, legal, and accessibility. So I'd like to go through each area and get everyone's input. Who'd like to start?

transcript.text: I need to flag a broadcast standards issue. I confirmed with the network control room this afternoon that the Horizon Feature Award must run on a 10-second broadcast delay, with the acceptance microphone live through that delay. The current no-delay setting in the draft rundown is not approved. I have not updated the broadcast log yet, but this change needs to be reflected before we can sign off.

transcript.text: I need to flag a legal issue on my end. My review of the signed sponsor agreement found that the sponsor wall may not appear behind the Horizon Feature Award recipient. The backdrop must be the festival's neutral blue curtain, with no sponsor logo in that shot. I have not attached the clause to the ceremony file yet, but this change needs to be reflected in the rundown before I can sign off.
